messages:
emily: Quick note from today's QA: using VoiceOver on mac + Safari the filter chips read weirdly. It says 'Status, button, Status, selected' like it's duplicating and not reading counts. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/filter-announce.png rishi: Thanks. Repro steps you used? I want to try NVDA on Win too. emily: Steps: Projects > open Filters > Tab to toolbar > Tab into chip list. VO announces each chip twice and the focus lands on the container sometimes instead of the active chip. claire: That sounds like multiple tabbable elements inside the chip container. We originally left each chip as ``` claire: +1. Also add an aria-live region for the result count so screen readers announce total results when filters change: `
Showing 11 projects
` emily: For copy: visually we show \"Open (3)\" but SR reads parentheses oddly. Suggest keeping visual \"Open (3)\" but add aria-label=\"Open, 3 results\" on the option, or include a hidden comma: `, 3 results` ben: Accessibility nit: focus ring in dark theme is too soft. Current is box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) which fails contrast. Need a visible outline with >=3:1 contrast against dark background. Suggest outline: 2px solid #8FD3FF (approx 4.2:1). rishi: I'll update the token `--focus-ring` to #8FD3FF on dark theme and ensure we use `outline-offset: 2px` for clarity. Also add a test that checks computed contrast of outline vs background. claire: QA acceptance: 1) Tab lands on chip container then directly into active chip (single tab stop). 2) Arrow keys cycle options, VO announces 'option, selected' correctly. 3) Result count announced after filter change. 4) Focus ring meets contrast threshold. Please add these to the PR checklist. emily: Also run axe-core and manual VoiceOver steps. For Windows, check NVDA announces listbox/listitem correctly if we map to listbox/option, otherwise use role=\"radiogroup\"/radio pattern. Document both patterns in the ticket so PMs understand tradeoffs. ben: Small ARIA copy nit: prefer `aria-label` on the option versus changing visible label to avoid visual regressions. So keep \"Open (3)\" visually + `aria-label=\"Open, 3 results\"`. rishi: I'll include code samples, Storybook story demonstrating keyboard nav, and an Axe snapshot. I'll also add voiceover instructions in the PR: 'Safari on macOS: VoiceOver on (Cmd+F5) > Tab to Filters > Expect: \"Filters, listbox\" then \"Open, option, selected\". NVDA: Focus behavior should be similar.' axe-bot: Local axe run: violations found: duplicate interactive elements (2), color-contrast (focus ring). Predicted improvement after changes: violations -> 0-1. :white_check_mark: claire: Thanks all. Can someone own the PR? rishi? If you can tag @emily for UX sign-off and @ben for copy. rishi: I'll open it today. Will include regression tests + manual test steps in the description. emily: Perfect, thanks team! Small wins but important for keyboard + SR users. :sparkles:
